abilities.description: Reads fraying patterns across the skybridge network and predicts which span will fail next.
abilities.name: Decay Mapping

abilities.description: Navigates cloud tides and shifting island distances with brass instruments.
abilities.name: Wayfinding

characters.arc: Iselle begins as a lone, data-driven apprentice who believes maps alone will persuade people. At Ostrelune, the Starwardens refuse her charts, and she is forced to open the sealed archive's stolen-chart record and publicly admit Lumenvale's old wrong. By trading her certainty for honest testimony, she ends as a trusted envoy who unites the isles through listening as much as charting.
characters.description: A sixteen-year-old apprentice cartographer of Lumenvale, small and ink-stained, with wind-tangled auburn hair and a satchel of brass dividers and vellum rolls. Raised in the bell-tower archive after her mother, a wayfinder, was lost on a cloud-tide crossing, she has memorized the sweep of every skybridge and is the first to notice that the fraying follows a pattern across the isles.
characters.external_conflict: The Starwardens call her maps heresy and the Circle's elders forbid her from sharing the sealed archive charts.
characters.flaw: She trusts numbers over people and dismisses anyone whose beliefs her charts cannot confirm.
characters.goal: Present her decay-pattern maps to all four enclaves and persuade them to rejoin rune-stone and silverthread in the failing keystones.
characters.internal_conflict: She longs to belong to the Circle yet suspects its sealed archive is part of the problem.
characters.motivation: To honor her lost mother's work by proving the realm can be charted back to wholeness.
characters.name: Iselle Vantor

abilities.description: Senses incoming tide shifts from wind and cloud color.
abilities.name: Cloud-Tide Reading

characters.arc: Orlan starts as an overprotective guardian who withholds how Iselle's mother died. When a cloud tide nearly strands them on a cracked span, he confesses the truth. Freed from his secret, he stops shielding Iselle and lets her lead the crossing alone.
characters.description: A grizzled master wayfinder of Lumenvale in his sixties, with a silver braid, weathered hands, and a patched sky-coat. He was Iselle's mother's partner and has quietly taught the girl since her loss.
characters.external_conflict: The Circle's elders threaten to strip his guild standing if he aids her.
characters.flaw: He hides painful truths to shield people from them.
characters.goal: Smuggle Iselle safely past the Circle's elders and across the bridges to the other isles.
characters.internal_conflict: He fears guilt over the crossing that killed his partner more than he fears the drift.
characters.motivation: To keep the promise he made to Iselle's mother that the girl would be protected.
characters.name: Orlan Veyth

abilities.description: Spins and splices living silverthread into keystone-grade cord.
abilities.name: Silverthread Weaving

abilities.description: Talks her way past guards and guildmasters.
abilities.name: Smooth Talk

characters.arc: Maren starts as an impulsive journeyman who lies to bend rules. After she is caught stealing thread and exposed before her guild, she must tell the truth publicly to justify the act. Honest and unashamed, she ends as the guild's voice for sharing silverthread.
characters.description: A quick-witted Threadwright journeyman of Vellamar, seventeen, with calloused fingers, cropped dark hair, and silverthread bracelets she spins herself. She watches her guild's stores run low while elders hoard them as leverage.
characters.external_conflict: Threadwright elders guard the silverthread supply and punish defectors.
characters.flaw: She acts impulsively and lies easily to get her way.
characters.goal: Secretly deliver silverthread to a keystone repair against her guild's wishes.
characters.internal_conflict: Loyalty to her guild clashes with her conviction that its leverage is killing the realm.
characters.motivation: To keep her younger siblings and her harbor town from being stranded as the bridges fail.
characters.name: Maren Dulcet

abilities.description: Carves resonant rune-stones for skybridge keystones.
abilities.name: Rune-Carving

characters.arc: Tavrin starts as a silent obedient smith who defers to the matriarchs. When Maren arrives at Cindrelle under the Oath of Passage and the two joint-test a keystone that holds, he must choose between clan law and the proof in his hands. He openly shares the rune technique and becomes the clans' reformer.
characters.description: A broad-shouldered Emberwright rune-smith of Cindrelle in his twenties, soot-darkened with amber-lit eyes and a quiet manner. He carves rune-stones in the glowing caverns and privately doubts his clan's secrecy.
characters.external_conflict: The clan matriarchs forbid sharing techniques with Threadwrights, who they blame for the First Fraying.
characters.flaw: He is conflict-averse and defers to authority even when he knows better.
characters.goal: Carve a new rune-stone and test it with Threadwright silverthread.
characters.internal_conflict: He reveres his clan's tradition yet sees it dooming the realm.
characters.motivation: To prove his clan's craft can mend the bridges rather than merely guard secrets.
characters.name: Tavrin Ashgrove

abilities.description: Measures island drift with glass and brass instruments.
abilities.name: Star-Reading

abilities.description: Her pronouncements sway the whole Ostrelune enclave.
abilities.name: Moral Authority

characters.arc: Sorrel starts as a serene guardian of prophecy who dismisses all evidence against it. When Iselle's chart matches Sorrel's own hidden measurements during the Closing of the Archive reckoning, she is forced to face her doubt. She ends by opening the observatories to Iselle and lending the Starwardens' calculations to the bridge repair.
characters.description: The elderly leader of the Starwardens at Ostrelune, tall and pale in a star-embroidered robe, with eyes clouded by decades at the observatory glass. She calmly believes the drift is fate and that resisting it invites a worse ruin.
characters.external_conflict: Iselle's charts and the Circle openly challenge her authority.
characters.flaw: She is dogmatic and treats contrary evidence as temptation.
characters.goal: Stop Iselle's maps from reaching the other enclaves and keep the isles at peace through acceptance.
characters.internal_conflict: Her private measurements have begun to contradict her prophecy, and she refuses to look.
characters.motivation: To spare the realm the panic and violence she believes resisting fate will cause.
characters.name: High Warden Sorrel Ashmere

relationships.description: Orlan Veyth is Iselle Vantor's mentor and guardian, but his habit of hiding the truth about her mother's death strains her trust in him.
High Warden Sorrel Ashmere opposes Iselle Vantor, branding her maps as heresy and blocking her from the other isles.
Maren Dulcet and Tavrin Ashgrove become uneasy allies, joining silverthread and rune-stone in defiance of their rival guilds.
Tavrin Ashgrove at first distrusts Maren Dulcet, since his clan blames Threadwrights like her for the First Fraying.
Iselle Vantor befriends Maren Dulcet in Vellamar, who gives her silverthread and a way to the other isles.
